1 (Currently amended): A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is configured to detect forces that are not solely related to swelling of the first battery cell.

11 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, and wherein the first sensor is configured to detect forces that are not solely related to swelling of the first battery cell.

17 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 11 further comprising: a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; and a second sensor positioned between the third battery cell and the second battery cell for detecting at least one force influencing the third battery cell, wherein the second sensor is configured to detect forces that are not solely related to swelling of the third battery cell.

21 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: force sensing material having a conductance that is configured to vary based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell, and wherein the force sensing material is further configured to detect forces that are not solely related to swelling of the first battery cell; and force sensing circuitry coupled to the force sensing material, wherein the force sensing circuitry is configured to produce a force output signal based on the conductance of the force sensing material. 

25 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises a contact sensor configured to detect forces that are not solely related to swelling of the first battery cell. 

26 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises a pressure sensitive ink configured to detect forces that are not solely related to swelling of the first battery cell. 

27 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises at least one of a polymer membrane binary switch and a discrete dome switch configured to detect forces that are not solely related to swelling of the first battery cell.
